Vacancy in Dr Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Melghat
Monday, 01 April 2024
3628 Hits
Applications on plain paper along with complete bio-data with necessary experience certificates / testimonials are invited for the following posts for Dr. Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Melghat which must reach the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) latest by 22/04/2024. Applications may also be sent on email ID (
secretaryoffice@mgims.ac.in
)
alongwith the hard copy.
Gynaecologist (1 post)
Paediatrician (1 post)
Anaesthesiologist (1 post)
General Duty Medical Officer (1 post)
Required Qualification:
1 to 3: MBBS with MCI recognized Post-graduate Degree/Diploma in concerned subject. For 4: MBBS.
Candidates with previous experience of working in Hospital, Out patient, Inpatient departments, M.J.P.J.A.Y. scheme and Community Health Services will be preferred.
Salary:
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society.
SECRETARY
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
